text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All the runners put their hearts and<n>souls into the
Arima Kinen, but it's<n>Grass Wonder who ultimately
stands<n>alone at the top.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is in tears, having<n>trained so hard
only to come up short.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder thanks her for giving it<n>everything
she had and praises her<n>efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder has reached a new<n>plateau.
However, her journey is far<n>from over.
